title: *Minutes From Downtown* - City View Nest!
description:
Experience Nashville in style! This modern 1-bedroom condo in City Heights is just minutes from downtown and only 2.5 miles from the buzz of Broadway.  With sleek amenities, a fully equipped kitchen, and cozy living space, it’s perfect for a weekend getaway or extended stay. Relax and recharge enjoying stunning city views from your private balcony. Close to top attractions, dining, and entertainment—your ideal Nashville retreat awaits!

The space
**Downtown Views & Modern Comfort – Top-Floor Corner Condo**  

Welcome to your perfect Nashville getaway! This top-floor corner condo offers stunning views of downtown and a peaceful retreat just minutes from all the action.  

🛏 **Sleep & Relax:**  
- 1  bedroom with a plush queen bed  
- Queen sleeper sofa in the living room 

🍽 **Cook & Dine:**  
- Full kitchen stocked with pots, pans, and cooking essentials  
- Enjoy homemade meals or a quick breakfast before heading out  

🚿 **Refresh & Recharge:**  
- Large bathroom with a walk-in shower  
- In-unit washer & dryer for added convenience  

🌆 **Unbeatable Location & Amenities:**  
- Private balcony with incredible city views  
- Elevator access & free parking  
- Easy check-in with smart lock
- Just minutes from downtown—close to the excitement but in a quiet area to unwind  

Whether you're here for music, food, or fun, this stylish and comfortable condo is the ideal home base for your Nashville adventure. Book now and experience the best of Music City! 🎶✨

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire condo. There is also a rooftop deck on the 5th floor, accessible by elevator. This is a shared space for all building residents.

Other things to note
Parking:

There are spots available in the parking lot behind the building. Spots are first come first serve. Any additional needed parking can be found on any surrounding street for free.
